# PlayStation
> Official PlayStation website for consoles, games, accessories, services, support, and the PlayStation Store.

PlayStation.com is Sony Interactive Entertainment’s primary web presence for PlayStation hardware, first-party games, subscriptions, account services, support resources, and regional storefront access.

## Main
- [PlayStation Home](https://www.playstation.com/): Official entry point for PlayStation consoles, games, services, and promotions.
- [PS5](https://www.playstation.com/ps5/): Overview of PlayStation 5 consoles, features, accessories, and games.
- [PS4](https://www.playstation.com/ps4/): Information about PlayStation 4 consoles, features, and supported experiences.
- [Games](https://www.playstation.com/games/): Browse PlayStation games, franchises, releases, and featured titles.
- [Accessories](https://www.playstation.com/accessories/): Explore official PlayStation accessories for console and audio experiences.
- [PlayStation Store](https://store.playstation.com/): Digital storefront for games, add-ons, subscriptions, and media content.

## Consoles
- [PlayStation 5](https://www.playstation.com/ps5/): Main PS5 hub covering hardware, features, and ecosystem details.
- [PS5 Console](https://www.playstation.com/ps5/ps5-console/): Product page for the standard PlayStation 5 console.
- [PS5 Digital Edition](https://www.playstation.com/ps5/ps5-digital-edition/): Product page for the all-digital PS5 console model.
- [PS5 Pro](https://www.playstation.com/ps5/ps5-pro/): Overview of the enhanced PS5 Pro console and capabilities.
- [PlayStation 4](https://www.playstation.com/ps4/): PS4 platform overview with hardware and game information.
- [PS4 Pro](https://www.playstation.com/ps4/ps4-pro/): Details on the higher-performance PlayStation 4 Pro console.

## Games and Franchises
- [Games Hub](https://www.playstation.com/games/): Central directory for PlayStation games across genres and platforms.
- [Marvel's Spider-Man 2](https://www.playstation.com/games/marvels-spider-man-2/): Game page with features, media, and purchase information.
- [God of War Ragnarök](https://www.playstation.com/games/god-of-war-ragnarok/): Official game overview, editions, and story details.
- [The Last of Us](https://www.playstation.com/games/the-last-of-us-part-i/): Franchise game page for The Last of Us Part I.
- [Horizon Forbidden West](https://www.playstation.com/games/horizon-forbidden-west/): Official page for Horizon Forbidden West and related content.
- [Gran Turismo 7](https://www.playstation.com/games/gran-turismo-7/): Racing title overview with features and edition information.
- [Helldivers 2](https://www.playstation.com/games/helldivers-2/): Cooperative action game page with trailers and details.
- [Astro Bot](https://www.playstation.com/games/astro-bot/): Official page for Astro Bot with gameplay and release information.

## Services and Subscriptions
- [PlayStation Plus](https://www.playstation.com/ps-plus/): Subscription service for online multiplayer, monthly games, and catalog access.
- [PlayStation Plus Games Catalog](https://www.playstation.com/ps-plus/games/): Browse games available through PlayStation Plus membership tiers.
- [PlayStation Stars](https://www.playstation.com/playstation-stars/): Loyalty program with campaigns, collectibles, and rewards information.
- [PlayStation App](https://www.playstation.com/playstation-app/): Mobile companion app for messaging, purchases, and remote downloads.
- [Remote Play](https://www.playstation.com/remote-play/): Stream PlayStation games to supported devices over network connections.
- [PlayStation Network](https://www.playstation.com/playstation-network/): Overview of PSN services, connectivity, and account ecosystem.

## Accessories
- [Accessories Hub](https://www.playstation.com/accessories/): Central page for official PlayStation controllers, audio, and peripherals.
- [DualSense Wireless Controller](https://www.playstation.com/accessories/dualsense-wireless-controller/): Features and color options for the PS5 wireless controller.
- [DualSense Edge Wireless Controller](https://www.playstation.com/accessories/dualsense-edge-wireless-controller/): Pro controller with customizable controls and profiles.
- [PlayStation Portal Remote Player](https://www.playstation.com/accessories/playstation-portal-remote-player/): Dedicated handheld device for PS5 Remote Play sessions.
- [PULSE Elite Wireless Headset](https://www.playstation.com/accessories/pulse-elite-wireless-headset/): Wireless gaming headset with PlayStation Link support.
- [PULSE Explore Wireless Earbuds](https://www.playstation.com/accessories/pulse-explore-wireless-earbuds/): Wireless earbuds designed for low-latency PlayStation audio.
- [Access Controller](https://www.playstation.com/accessories/access-controller/): Customizable accessibility controller kit for PS5 players.

## PlayStation Store
- [PlayStation Store](https://store.playstation.com/): Official digital marketplace for PlayStation content and subscriptions.
- [Latest Games](https://store.playstation.com/category/85448d87-aa7b-4318-9997-7d25f4d275a4): Browse newly released and recently added PlayStation titles.
- [Deals and Discounts](https://store.playstation.com/category/6e7c8679-1e0d-4d2f-8adc-2b6a2f8b0d94): Discover current sales, promotions, and discounted digital content.
- [PS5 Games](https://store.playstation.com/category/0d1d4f3f-0f1c-4f5d-bf2d-7f7f4f6f5f5a): Store category for games built for PlayStation 5.
- [PS4 Games](https://store.playstation.com/category/998f3b1f-0f1c-4f5d-bf2d-7f7f4f6f5f5a): Store category for games available on PlayStation 4.
- [Subscriptions](https://store.playstation.com/category/4d87c6af-1e0d-4d2f-8adc-2b6a2f8b0d94): Purchase and manage subscription products through the store.

## Support
- [Support Home](https://www.playstation.com/support/): Entry point for troubleshooting, repairs, and account help resources.
- [PlayStation Support](https://www.playstation.com/support/playstation-support/): General support portal for hardware, software, and services.
- [Account and Security](https://www.playstation.com/support/account/): Help for sign-in, password, security, and account management issues.
- [PS5 Support](https://www.playstation.com/support/hardware/ps5/): Troubleshooting and setup help for PlayStation 5 hardware.
- [PS4 Support](https://www.playstation.com/support/hardware/ps4/): Troubleshooting and setup help for PlayStation 4 hardware.
- [Repairs](https://www.playstation.com/support/hardware/playstation-repairs/): Start repair requests and review service options for devices.
- [PlayStation Network Status](https://status.playstation.com/): Check current operational status of PlayStation online services.

## Account and Safety
- [Account Management](https://www.playstation.com/support/account/): Support resources for account settings, access, and recovery.
- [Family and Parental Controls](https://www.playstation.com/support/account/ps5-parental-controls-spending-limits/): Guidance for managing child accounts and spending restrictions.
- [Online Safety](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/support/account/online-safety/): Information about safer play, reporting, and moderation practices.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.playstation.com/legal/privacy-policy/): Details on PlayStation data collection, use, and privacy rights.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.playstation.com/legal/psn-terms-of-service/): Legal terms governing PlayStation Network and related services.
- [Health Warning](https://www.playstation.com/legal/health-warning/): Safety guidance related to gameplay and hardware usage.

## News and Editorial
- [PlayStation Blog](https://blog.playstation.com/): Official editorial site for announcements, interviews, and feature stories.
- [Latest News](https://blog.playstation.com/category/news/): Recent PlayStation announcements and platform updates.
- [PS5 News](https://blog.playstation.com/category/ps5/): Articles focused on PS5 games, hardware, and features.
- [PS VR2 News](https://blog.playstation.com/category/ps-vr2/): Coverage of PlayStation VR2 games, updates, and announcements.
- [PlayStation Indies](https://blog.playstation.com/category/indies/): Editorial coverage of independent games on PlayStation platforms.
- [State of Play](https://blog.playstation.com/tag/state-of-play/): Posts and recaps related to State of Play presentations.

## Legal and Corporate
- [Legal](https://www.playstation.com/legal/): Central hub for PlayStation legal notices and policies.
- [About SIE](https://www.playstation.com/corporate/about-us/): Overview of Sony Interactive Entertainment and company information.
- [Careers](https://www.playstation.com/corporate/playstation-careers/): Employment and recruiting information for PlayStation teams.
- [Press Releases](https://www.playstation.com/corporate/press-releases/): Official corporate announcements and media communications.
- [Accessibility](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/accessibility/): Information about accessibility features across PlayStation products.
- [Modern Slavery Statement](https://www.playstation.com/legal/modern-slavery-statement/): Corporate disclosure regarding supply chains and labor practices.
